quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui Chemicals results presentation: Q1 FY2026 Earnings Presentation Slides (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ICT Solutions Q1 FY2026: sales revenue 77.8 billion yen (69.0 a year earlier, +8.8) and operating income before special items 11.1 billion yen (9.0, +2.1); semiconductor and optical materials rose on sales volume and foreign exchange, with demand growth particularly in semiconductor markets. Company-wide, semiconductor applications increased due to growing demand in cutting-edge applications driven by the expansion of generative AI.
